description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 986 - Order to amend the Triennial Authorisation Fee in Notification No. 936 Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1708/16 of 31.05.2011
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves regulatory amendments to the Excise Ordinance, specifically modifying licensing fees and categories for hotels. It is issued by the Minister of Finance under statutory powers (Sections 25 and 32 of the Excise Ordinance) and contains detailed regulatory provisions about license classifications and fees. While it names a minister, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only his title "Minister of Finance") and the core content is regulatory in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
